== Description ==

[[Mark Billings]] (left, ponytail, glasses, patterned long-sleeve shirt, looking down at cards), [[AJ Hatoum]] (front right, light brown hair, glasses, black graphic tee, name tag, tattoo, peach-can), [[Apollo Chu]] (mid-left, curly hair, glasses, grey Alaska hoodie), [[Matt Scott]] (mid-right, black Nike track jacket, short dark hair, orange sleeves), [[Scott Lingrell]] (background left, navy Union jersey), [[Greg Shaw]] (background, red “MAKE OCTOBER” hoodie), [[Brian Fred]] (background, bald, black tank, shoulder tattoo), and [[Karl Koenig]] (background right, yellow graphic tee) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
